offering_description.value: Sells property and casualty, employee benefits and other insurance policies to businesses and individuals. Places coverage with insurance carriers and advises clients on risk management, earning commissions and fees.

primary_products.value: property and casualty insurance; employee benefits insurance; personal lines insurance; surety bonds; flood insurance

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; risk management consulting; claims advocacy; program administration

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses of all sizes, including contractors, manufacturers and nonprofits; B2C: individuals buying personal auto, home and life coverage; B2G: municipalities and other public entities

end_markets.value: construction; healthcare; hospitality; manufacturing; real estate

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions paid by insurance carriers on policies placed for clients; service fees: fees for risk consulting, claims handling and program administration
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places insurance between carriers and clients, taking commissions from carriers and fees from clients; service provider: provides risk advisory and claims services to businesses and individuals

geography_served.value: US national: nearly all US states, some international operations in Canada, Europe and Bermuda

specialization.value: related lines: retail brokerage, national programs, wholesale brokerage and binding authority services

distribution_channels.value: own locations: local retail offices across the United States; direct sales: account executives selling directly to businesses and individuals; partners / resellers: affinity groups and association partners that refer members; agents / brokers: wholesale brokers and program partners placing specialty coverage
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state insurance producer licenses from state insurance departments, plus rules on premium handling and consumer protection
